## Purpose

Manages owners, their pets, pet types and pet visits: JPA entities, Spring Data repositories, MVC controllers and form validation. [verified: owner/Owner.java:48-50, owner/OwnerController.java:59-186]

- Package root: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/owner`
- Templates: `src/main/resources/templates/owners/`, `templates/pets/` [verified: git ls-files]

## Entry points

- `OwnerController` — GET `/owners/new`, POST `/owners/new`, GET `/owners/find`, GET `/owners` (search by last-name prefix, page size 5), GET/POST `/owners/{ownerId}/edit`, GET `/owners/{ownerId}` [verified: OwnerController.java:72-178]
- `PetController` — base `/owners/{ownerId}`; GET/POST `/pets/new`, GET/POST `/pets/{petId}/edit` [verified: PetController.java:48, 100-144]
- `VisitController` — GET/POST `/owners/{ownerId}/pets/{petId}/visits/new` [verified: VisitController.java:90-97]

## Key classes

- `Owner` — aggregate root; holds `pets`, has `addPet`, `getPet(...)`, `addVisit(petId, visit)` [verified: Owner.java:67-70, 100, 176]
- `Pet`, `Visit` — child entities reached only through `Owner` [verified: Pet.java:56-57; VisitController.java:108-109 saves via owner]
- `PetType` — lookup entity; `PetTypeRepository.findPetTypes()` has a JPQL `@Query` [verified: PetTypeRepository.java:36]
- `OwnerRepository extends JpaRepository<Owner,Integer>` with `findByLastNameStartingWith(String, Pageable)` [verified: OwnerRepository.java:36,45]
- `PetValidator`, `PetTypeFormatter` — form validation and type formatting [verified: file names in owner/; behaviour inferred]

## Data owned

- `Owner` → `owners`; `Pet` → `pets`; `PetType` → `types`; `Visit` → `visits` [verified: Owner.java:49, Pet.java:45, PetType.java:27, Visit.java:36]
- Relations: Owner 1-N Pet (`owner_id`, cascade ALL, EAGER), Pet N-1 PetType (`type_id`), Pet 1-N Visit (`pet_id`, cascade ALL, EAGER) [verified: Owner.java:67-68, Pet.java:52-57]
- DB constraint `unique_owner_pet_name (owner_id, name)` on pets; `last_name` and pet `name` are case-insensitive columns in H2 [verified: db/h2/schema.sql:39, 48, 55]
- Migrations: none. Schema is in `src/main/resources/db/{h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql` [verified: git ls-files]

## Gotchas

- `@InitBinder` disallows binding of `id` and `*.id` in each controller; keep this when adding forms [verified: OwnerController.java:59-62, PetController.java:89-98]
- `@ModelAttribute` methods load the owner (and pet/visit) on every request in their controller, and throw `IllegalArgumentException` on a missing owner or pet [verified: OwnerController.java:64-70, VisitController.java:63-74]
- `VisitController.loadPetWithVisit` adds a new empty `Visit` to the pet on every request, including GET [verified: VisitController.java:78-80]
- Duplicate pet names are checked in code and by the DB unique constraint, with `DataIntegrityViolationException` handling on create [verified: PetController.java:111, 124-134]
- Eager fetching of pets and visits on Owner, with `default_batch_fetch_size=16`; `open-in-view=false` [verified: Owner.java:67, application.properties:11,13]
- Validation of dates (birth date not in future, visit date after today) happens in controllers, not entities [verified: PetController.java:115-118, VisitController.java:100-102]
- Error messages in controllers are hardcoded English strings, not i18n keys [verified: OwnerController.java:80,85,157]
